one_line: AI financing surges, new open‑weight models launch, and safety research addresses misuse incidents.

themes.title: Corporate financing fuels AI growth
themes.text: Thrive Holdings announced a $15.3 billion acquisition of ADT, while Microsoft seeks at least $25 billion in a bond sale for AI‑related spending. AM Intelligence is raising up to $3 billion for Nvidia Vera Rubin chips, Nvidia is discussing credit guarantees for an Anthropic data center and has committed $3 billion to Meta’s equity offering.

stories.headline: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings to acquire ADT for $15.3 billion
Microsoft aims to raise at least $25 billion in US investment‑grade bond sale
AM Intelligence seeks up to $3 billion to fund Nvidia Vera Rubin chip purchase
Nvidia in talks to back Nscale with credit guarantees for Anthropic data center
Nvidia commits $3 billion to Meta share sale and expands AI infrastructure partnership

themes.title: New open‑weight AI models released
themes.text: Mistral AI released the weights for its 1‑trillion‑parameter multimodal model Le Chonk, highlighting strong coding performance. Microsoft published the 4‑billion‑parameter vision‑language model Mage‑VL‑Cowork on Hugging Face, achieving the highest accuracy among 4 B models.

stories.headline: Mistral releases weights for 1‑trillion‑parameter Le Chonk model
Microsoft releases Mage‑VL‑Cowork, a 4B vision‑language model for hybrid computer use

themes.title: Safety research and AI misuse incidents
themes.text: Researchers introduced the ShallowDefend framework to improve multi‑turn safety of large language models. OpenAI updated its Model Spec around five core values, while Chinese state‑linked hackers used DeepSeek AI via ARTEX to breach over 200 firms, and a malicious Claude Code VS Code extension attempted to install an SSH backdoor on up to 5,000 users.

stories.headline: ShallowDefend framework improves multi‑turn safety for large language models
OpenAI revises Model Spec around five core values
China‑linked hackers used DeepSeek AI via ARTEX to breach 200+ firms in 11 days
Malicious Claude Code VS Code extension adds SSH backdoor, affecting up to 5,000 users
